words.example: Could you nudge the vendor about the missing quotation?
words.exampleZh: 报价还没到，你能催一下供应商吗？

words.example: Circulate the holiday notice today so people can plan leave.
words.exampleZh: 今天就把假期通知传阅出去，大家才好安排休假。

words.example: Please loop in the ward clerk.
words.exampleZh: 请把病区文员拉进沟通。

words.example: I am out of office until Thursday.
The request is still in progress.
Automated dispensing on ward six kept this dose locked in the cabinet.
words.exampleZh: 六病区的自动发药柜把这一剂锁在柜子里，没有发出去。

words.example: ADC (Automated Dispensing Cabinet) on ward six is missing the night narcotic count.
words.exampleZh: 六病区的ADC（自动发药柜）缺了夜间麻醉药品盘点。

words.example: Update the infusion library before the new heparin protocol goes live.
words.exampleZh: 新的肝素方案上线之前，先更新输液泵药库。

words.example: Device integration stopped pulling heart rates from the ICU monitors.
words.exampleZh: 设备集成不再从重症监护仪上取心率。

words.meaning: 网络时间协议（Network Time Protocol）
words.example: NTP (Network Time Protocol) drifted, so medication times no longer match the monitors.
words.exampleZh: NTP（网络时间协议）发生了漂移，用药时间和监护仪对不上了。
